text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Matikanefukukitaru's earnest request,
we came to a shrine, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, O Spirit of Good Cheer~~!
Please quell your anger and grant me energyyy~~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...*Sigh*, it's no good.
I can't seem to get any energy up at all."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah man... I just can't seem to shake this fatigue.
Though I do have a pretty good idea why.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been able to visit the shrine lately because I was so busy, so the god of energy must be angry with me...!
I just know it...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, no choice then.
I'll throw in another 50 yen offering... and try one more time!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems fatigue is still lingering.
For the sake of her future success, should I reconsider her upcoming race schedule...?
